ivermectin: A compound of the avermectin group, used as an anthelmintic in veterinary medicine and as a treatment for river blindness.
ivied: Overgrown with ivy or another climbing plant.
ivory: The hard white form of dentin which forms the tusks of elephants, walruses and other animals.
ivy: Any of several woody, climbing, or trailing evergreen plants of the genus Hedera.
